question: Will Lionel Messi win the Golden Ball at the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
rules:
This market will resolve to the player who wins the Golden Ball award for the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

In the event of a tie, this market will resolve according to the official winner as determined by FIFA rules. If multiple winners are announced then this market will resolve to the player whose listed last name comes first alphabetically.

If the 2026 FIFA World Cup is cancelled, postponed after August 2, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or there is otherwise no winner declared within that timeframe, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from FIFA; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

evidence.excerpt: Far from their best, Argentina avoided a huge World Cup upset as they eventually overcame a stubborn Cabo Verde side to reach the last 16. Messi scored his seventh goal of the tournament in the 3-2 victory. FIFA described Argentina's players suffering cramp and fatigue, with Egypt their next opponent.

evidence.publisher: Reuters, syndicated by Sports Radio KWSN
evidence.excerpt: Reigning champions Argentina needed an extra-time own goal to clinch a dramatic 3-2 victory over Cape Verde and a place in the last 16. Messi gave Argentina the lead in the 29th minute with his seventh goal of the tournament and delivered the corner that produced the decisive own goal. Reuters reported that, Messi aside, Argentina were largely bereft of ideas against Cape Verde's defence.

Argentina and Egypt were scheduled to meet in the round of 16 in Atlanta at noon on Tuesday, July 7. Argentina reached the fixture by outlasting Cape Verde in extra time. Messi, 39, and Mohamed Salah, 34, had previously met twice in the UEFA Champions League, but this would be their first meeting representing their national teams.

El Doce reported from Argentina's last open training session before the round-of-16 match against Egypt. Lionel Messi appeared at the session, described as relaxed and happy amid high summer temperatures. The segment aired on Noticiero Doce on July 6, 2026.

France captain Kylian Mbappé scored twice as France opened its campaign with a 3-1 victory over Senegal. Messi responded with a hat-trick in Argentina's 3-0 win against Algeria. Le Monde reported that the two opening performances attracted international media attention.

Lionel Messi became the first man to win the World Cup Golden Ball twice. After winning the award at Brazil 2014, he received it again at Qatar 2022 after providing seven goals and three assists. Mbappé and Luka Modrić received the Silver Ball and Bronze Ball respectively.
